title: Website development in Tucson, Arizona | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs builds websites, customer portals, and web applications for Tucson businesses, quoted at a fixed price after a scoping call.
h1: Website and web application development in Tucson
intro: Many Tucson businesses reach customers through a mix of Google search, referrals, and seasonal visitors. Restaurants, tour operators, contractors, clinics, and retailers often have a site built years ago on Wix, Squarespace, or WordPress that lists services but does not let a customer request a quote, book an appointment, or complete an intake form. Website and web application development applies when a business needs a site that does that work, or an application that replaces a paper or email process.

Creosote Labs builds marketing websites with clear services, pricing, and a way to book or contact the business, along with customer-facing tools such as quote requests, bookings, intake forms, and portals for Tucson companies. For businesses whose staff manage a process by email and spreadsheet, we build web applications that replace it. Hosting setup, domain configuration, and handover with documentation are part of every project. Projects are quoted after a scoping call at a fixed price.
projects: A marketing site for a Tucson landscaping company with service pages, pricing ranges, and a quote request form that reaches the owner's inbox.
An online booking tool for a desert tour operator that checks availability, collects waivers, and takes deposits through Square.
A patient intake portal for a physical therapy clinic that replaces paper forms and sends completed records to the front desk.
A customer portal for a wholesale distributor where accounts view order history, reorder, and download invoices.
A rental application workflow for a property management company that replaces a PDF form and an email chain.

faqs.q: How is a website project priced?
faqs.a: Each project receives a fixed-price quote after a scoping call. There is no hourly billing, and hosting and domain setup are included.

faqs.q: What do we need to provide?
faqs.a: The business provides a logo, photos, service descriptions, and pricing if it will be published. If the site includes a booking or quote tool, we also need the questions the business asks a customer today.

faqs.q: Can a Tucson business update the site after handover?
faqs.a: Yes. Every project ends with hosting configured in the business's own accounts and written documentation for updating content.
